CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The little.
   B. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust
